subject: Rebate request for delayed multi-region routing feature
messages:
From: Tess Harper <tess@cumulusanalytics.com>
To: michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cumulusanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Rebate request — multi-region routing delay

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the call today. As discussed, our team at Cumulus Analytics is in the middle of launching a geo-failover flow that depends on Redwood's multi-region routing (GRR) capability. We were told GRR would be available in GA by mid-July, but the internal timeline slipped and the feature is still in limited preview. That gap has forced us to build a brittle fallback that increases our operational cost and latency to customers across EU/APAC.

Given the missed milestone and the impact to our launch, we need a commercial concession while we wait for full GRR availability. Specifically, procurement is requesting a rebate equivalent to 20% of our monthly hosted spend for July and August, or a pre-paid credit of the same value applied to upcoming invoices.

We want to keep moving with Redwood (we like the runtime and the latency profile), but this is material to our board-backed timeline. Please let me know what approvals you need and how quickly you can confirm.

Attaching our high-level impact note and an updated MAP.

— Tess
Tess Harper
Head of Platform
Cumulus Analytics

Attachments: Cumulus_rebate_proposal_v1.pdf, MAP_Cumulus_2027-07-31.docx

Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -07:00

Hi Tess — thanks for the clear note and for sharing the MAP. I’m sorry the timeline slippage created extra work for your team.

I’ve looped in Laura (product) for a timeline confirmation and Vivek/Rishi to coordinate a commercial proposal. To set expectations internally: procurement-level concessions like a multi-month percentage rebate need finance sign-off. I will push for an expedited review and share a proposal by EOD tomorrow.

Action items:
- Laura: confirm ship window for full GRR and any interim mitigations we can offer.
- Vivek/Rishi: draft concession options (rebate vs. credits vs. support uplift) and an AP-friendly SOW amendment.
- Tess/Alex: please confirm whether Cumulus prefers a one-time credit or rolling invoice rebates.

Thanks — I’ll follow up after the internal call.

Best,

Subject: Re: Rebate request — multi-region routing delay

Folks — quick product update for the thread.

Short version: full GRR GA will be shipped in ~9 weeks (targeting 2027-10-04) based on current QA/infra gating. We do have a staged mitigation rolling next week (traffic steering proxies + region-aware caching) that reduces outage risk but does not satisfy the full API surface customers expect. The mitigation will lower your failure rate by ~60% for common flows, but it does not replace GRR for cross-region token placement or cost-optimized routing.

Recommendation for commercial team: we should avoid a blanket 20% multi-month rebate. Suggested compromises:
- Option A (recommended): 12% invoice credit for two billing cycles + free premium support for the same period (include 2x on-call rotations).
- Option B: 15% one-time prepaid credit applied to next invoice + explicit MAP milestones for GRR staging (dates + rollback triggers).

Rationale: the staged mitigation meaningfully reduces risk; the product ETA is firm-ish but still dependent on a couple of infra items. If Sales wants a larger concession, we should get sign-off from Finance + VP Sales to protect revenue.

I’m happy to join a customer call to explain the mitigation and timeline.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Product — Serving and Runtime
Redwood Inference

Marissa — forwarding the thread and Tess's ask. Customer is asking for 20% for two months. Laura proposes 12% x2 cycles or 15% one-time prepay. We prefer to accept Option A or B to preserve the deal and avoid churn; Cumulus has expansion potential in Q1 and is already in pilot.

I attached a short MAP and a suggested amendment to the SOW (MAP_Cumulus_2027-07-31.docx).

Request: please confirm whether Finance can approve Option A (12% x2 + premium support) as a one-time concessional write-down, and whether we can handle this as a billing credit (not cash refund). If you need VP-level approval, please flag — we need a response today to keep the board timeline intact.
